title: 2024 Topps Chrome Update Adrian Houser #USC58 RayWave Refractor NY Mets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2024 Topps Chrome Update trading card features Adrian Houser, a Major League Baseball player for the Mets. The card is a RayWave Refractor parallel variety, with a card size of 3½" x 2½". It is an original licensed reprint from the manufacturer, Topps Chrome Update. 

The card is unautographed and comes from the 2024 set. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection, especially those who follow the Mets. The card number is USC58 and it is a sports trading card. Get this unique piece of memorabilia today!
